content.value: A super conducting solenoid of 10 cm in diameter, 1 m in length and has 500 turns (12) of $\mathrm { N b } _ { 3 } \mathrm { S n }$ wire, whose critical field $\mathrm { B _ { c } }$ at 4.2 k is about 20 T and critical current density $\mathrm { J _ { c } }$ is $3 { \times } 1 0 ^ { 6 } \ \mathrm { A c m } ^ { - 2 }$ . What is the current necessary to set up a field of 5 T at the center of a solenoid? What is approximate energy stored in the solenoid? Assume that the critical current density decreases linearly with the applied …. and the field across the diameter of the solenoid is approximately uniform.
